templates.title: Address History Explanation Letter Template
templates.summary: How an address history explanation letter is laid out: each address with its dates, one plain sentence for any gap or overlap, and the proof you attach for each.
safePreview: Open by naming the request: the address history the application asks for and the years it covers.
List each address with its move-in and move-out month and year, most recent first.
Account for each gap or overlap in one plain sentence, such as staying with family between leases.
Name the proof you attach for each address, such as a lease, a utility bill or a bank statement showing it.
Close by asking the reviewer to say if they need another document for any period.

templates.title: Employment Gap Explanation Letter Template
templates.summary: How an employment gap explanation letter is laid out: the dates of the gap, the reason in a sentence or two, your current work, and the documents that show it.
safePreview: Name the gap: the month and year it started and ended.
Give the reason in one or two sentences, without detail the reviewer did not ask for, such as caregiving, study, a layoff or a move.
Say what you did during the gap only if it matters to the reviewer, such as a course you finished or freelance work.
State your current work: employer, role, start date, and pay if the reviewer asked for it.
Name the documents you attach, such as an offer letter or recent pay stubs, and close with the review step you are asking for.

templates.title: Bank Statement Deposit Explanation Letter Template
templates.primaryQuery: bank statement deposit explanation letter template
templates.summary: How a bank statement deposit explanation letter is built: source, date, and amount of each deposit, with proof attached and no fake documents.
safePreview: Identify each deposit by date, amount and account, exactly as the statement shows it.
Say where each deposit came from, such as a tax refund, the sale of a car, a transfer from your own savings, or a gift.
Name the document that proves each source, such as the refund notice, a bill of sale, the statement of the sending account, or a gift letter.
Say whether any of the money is a loan you have to repay.
Close by listing the attachments and asking the reviewer to say if anything else is needed.

templates.title: Rental Application Cover Letter Template
templates.summary: How a rental application cover letter is laid out: the unit and move-in date, who will live there, income in one line, any screening issue in plain words, and what is in the packet.
safePreview: Name the property and unit you are applying for, and your planned move-in date.
Introduce the household: who will live there, and any pets.
State your income in one line, the source and monthly amount, matching your pay stubs or award letter.
Mention your rental history briefly, and explain anything the screening will show in one or two factual sentences.
List the documents in your packet and how to reach you.

templates.title: Self-Employed Proof of Income Template
templates.primaryQuery: self employed proof of income template
templates.summary: How a self-employed proof of income letter is laid out: the business, income by period matching your tax returns, any big change explained, and the records attached.
safePreview: State the business: its name, what it does, and how long you have run it.
Give your income by period, such as the last two tax years and the year to date, matching your tax returns and profit-and-loss statement.
Explain any big change between periods in one or two factual sentences, such as a lost client, seasonal work or a new contract.
List the records you attach: tax returns, 1099 forms, a profit-and-loss statement and business bank statements.
Close by naming who can confirm the figures if the reviewer needs that, such as your tax preparer if you have one.
